states.claim: profile is the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; NULL if no EXIF profile exists.
exif points to the byte storage of the EXIF profile datum.
directory is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at exif+offset.
directory_stack entries store a directory pointer, entry index, and tag offset for later restoration.
q is an interior byte address within the directory region at directory+(12*entry)+2.
p is set to q+8 when the value fits inline in the directory entry.
p is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at exif+dir_offset when the value is stored at an offset.
exif_resources is a newly created splay tree used to track visited directory entries.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L577: (void *(*)(void *)) NULL,(void *(*)(void *)) NULL);

states.claim: exif_resources is destroyed at the end of the function.
value is a heap-allocated string returned by AcquireString or AcquireQuantumMemory, or NULL if allocation fails.
value is released with DestroyString after being used.
key is a heap-allocated string returned by AcquireString and released with DestroyString.
p is a pointer to a property value obtained from the image properties splay tree, or NULL if not found.

values.claim: tag_bytes is a 13-element int array indexed by format; valid format indices are 1..12, and tag_bytes[format] gives the per-component byte size (1,1,2,4,8,1,1,2,4,8,4,8 for formats 1..12).
number_bytes is computed as (size_t)components * tag_bytes[format]; the check number_bytes < components rejects overflow where the product wraps below the component count.
If number_bytes <= 4, p is set to q+8 (inline value within the 12-byte directory entry); otherwise p is set to exif+dir_offset after validating dir_offset and dir_offset+number_bytes against length.
q is computed as directory + 12*entry + 2, i.e. the start of the 12-byte IFD entry fields after the 2-byte count.
values.evidence: L609: q=(unsigned char *) (directory+(12*entry)+2);

values.claim: Before formatting, p is required to satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-tag_bytes[format], bounding the first component read.
values.evidence: L652: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-tag_bytes[format])))

values.claim: For EXIF_FMT_STRING/default, p is required to satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-number_bytes, bounding the byte-string read.
values.evidence: L733: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-number_bytes)))

values.claim: For BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING formats, value is allocated with AcquireQuantumMemory(number_bytes+1, sizeof(*value)) when ~((size_t)number_bytes) >= 1, and the loop writes value[0..number_bytes-1] then value[number_bytes]='\0'.
In EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions, p1 starts at p and is advanced by size bytes per component for components iterations, so the last component read is at p+(components-1)*size.

values.claim: For EXIF/GPS/Interop offset tags, offset is read as a signed long from p; a new directory is pushed only when (size_t)offset < length and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2.

The next-IFD offset is read from directory+2+12*number_entries only after checking that directory+2+12*number_entries+4 <= exif+length; the pushed directory is exif+offset when offset != 0 and (size_t)offset < length and level < MaxDirectoryStack-2.

values.claim: For '#'/'@' tag specifications, property is advanced by 6, n=strlen(property) must equal 4, n is divided by 4, and the hex parse loop shifts tag left by 4 per character.
length is set to GetStringInfoLength(profile) and must be at least 6 before scanning for the EXIF header, and at least 16 after the header is found.
id is read as a signed short from exif; id==0x4949 selects LSBEndian, id==0x4D4D selects MSBEndian, otherwise the function returns.
For all==2, key formatting uses tag_value ranges: tag_value < 0x10000 formats as #%04lx, tag_value < 0x20000 formats as @%04lx with tag_value & 0xffff, otherwise "unknown".
